process_journal.condition: Journal is created empty during setup and appended by the launch/cleanup paths. Per-event field requirements need event-discriminated validation; a single flat required_keys list only safely expresses event.
process_journal.shape: JSONL. Every event object has event. Event-specific fields are: started(role,pid,start_ticks); stop_requested(pid,start_ticks,pre_stop_exit_code,mode); stopped(pid,start_ticks,exit_code,absent,forced); listeners_drained(counts); cleanup_listeners_drained(counts). Cleanup may add a second stop_requested/stopped pair when the child is still live.

execution_oracle_boundary: This document establishes source paths and schemas only. It does not establish that any case ran, that a file exists in evidence, that a CLI rejected correctly, that PostgreSQL was isolated, or that the raw artifacts passed the private artifact checker.
